name: Thompson Washington D.C.
insider_take: This isn't your typical D.C. hotel – Thompson Washington D.C. brings Manhattan-style sophistication to Navy Yard with killer waterfront views and a scene that locals actually want to be part of.
whats_special: Located in the rapidly transformed Navy Yard district, this is D.C.'s first Thompson property and sits just steps from Nationals Park. The hotel occupies a prime spot along the Anacostia River with unobstructed water views – a rarity in the nation's capital. The rooftop bar offers panoramic vistas of the Capitol dome, Washington Monument, and river, making it one of the city's most Instagram-worthy perches.
pro_tip: Book a river-facing room on floors 7-12 for the best views, and hit the rooftop during golden hour – the lighting on the Capitol building is absolutely magical.
dont_miss: The Yards Park boardwalk is literally at your doorstep – perfect for morning runs with Capitol views. On game days, you can walk to Nationals Park in under 5 minutes. The nearby Wharf district (10-minute ride) offers some of D.C.'s hottest restaurants and the historic fish market that's been operating since 1805.
pros: Prime downtown location near major attractions and monuments
Contemporary design with modern amenities and stylish interiors
Rooftop bar with panoramic city views
Access to exclusive Hyatt Privé benefits and privileges
cons: Urban location with typical city noise levels
